issue.title: test_typing_space_inside_parens_shows_tail_ghost flakes under the parallel lane

task_type_fields.evidence: Fail then pass on an unchanged tree. sase tool run check 3acd4d900f214c6830bc663849aed9dd (pytest -n 7, host load about 15-24) failed this node: AssertionError assert '[^T] word' not in '[^T] word ...58,169,159)]'. The next serial run on that same tree (a10a6c6035 plus the uncommitted scope-sweep privatization, which does not import this test) passed. A later serial run on 092fd1db05 also passed. The test file is not in the eight commits between those SHAs. Observed fail rate 1 of 3, and the only failure was the parallel lane. Not caused by sase-1i4.

issue.creation_reason: The scoped check failed this prompt-bar test once under parallel load, and the same tree passed it on the next serial run. It is intermittent and not caused by the agent-scope epic.

payload.description: Parallel-lane flake seen during sase-1i4 landing; serial rerun passed
